stories.title: Elfed High School girls earn STEM award with Tata Steel
stories.summary: Twenty-two girls from Elfed High School in Buckley have earned a Bronze Industrial Cadet Award after completing a STEM programme with Tata Steel. The programme ran from October to June and was led by Debbie Jones Walters, Communication and Engagement Manager for Building Systems UK. stories.title: NatWest survey records sharper drop in Welsh business activity
stories.summary: Welsh private-sector firms cut jobs at the fastest rate in almost six years in May, according to a monthly business survey. stories.title: Wales’ housing minister pledges action for safe and affordable homes
stories.summary: Wales’ new housing minister has said everyone in Wales should have a “safe, warm home” – but admitted “this most basic of needs is out of reach for thousands of people”. stories.title: Around 200 runners took to the Airbus Broughton runway for a local children’s charity
stories.summary: Around 200 runners took to the runway at Airbus Broughton this morning for a 5km Fun Run. stories.title: North Wales Police e-bike and e-scooter seizures rise nine-fold in two years
stories.summary: North Wales Police seized 246 e-bikes and e-scooters last year, nine times the number taken off the roads two years earlier.
